name: SPA + API in TypeScript: Vue and NestJS
summary: One language end to end: a Vue single-page app and a NestJS API sharing types, with Postgres through Prisma. Angular, Spring Boot and ASP.NET Core are the listed swaps for teams on those stacks.

fitsWhen.says: a web app people sign in to
more than one developer shares the code

avoidWhen.says: pages must rank in search engines

frontend.why: Single-file components and an official router and store; Angular is the swap for teams that want one opinionated framework.

backend.why: Modules and dependency injection give a large codebase a shape; Spring Boot or ASP.NET Core when the team is on the JVM or .NET.

queue.why: Background jobs in the same language as the API.

auth.why: OIDC from a self-hosted identity provider, so SSO and roles are configuration rather than code.

infra.why: Compose locally and on one host.

testing.why: Vitest for both apps; Playwright end to end.

hosting.why: Containers near users without running a cluster.

services.name: web
responsibilities: Calls the API with a bearer token from Keycloak

services.name: api
responsibilities: Domain modules with guards for roles

dataStores.name: db
dataStores.purpose: System of record, migrated by Prisma Migrate

environments.name: dev
environments.hosting: docker compose: web, api, Postgres, Redis, Keycloak

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: A copy of production for checking a release

environments.name: prod
environments.hosting: Fly.io apps with managed Postgres and backups

stages.name: test
stages.does: vitest; API tests against a Postgres service

stages.name: deploy
stages.does: fly deploy on main (staging) and on tags (prod)

notes: Shared types live in a packages/shared workspace
Request ids propagated from web to API

security.auth: OIDC authorization code flow with PKCE against Keycloak; the API validates JWTs and roles
security.secrets: Fly secrets; nothing in the repository
notes: Validate every input at the API boundary and return typed errors, never stack traces.
Parameterised queries only (the ORM), so no SQL is built from strings.
Set secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies or short-lived tokens; rate-limit sign-in.
Check authorisation on every endpoint on the server, not only in the UI (OWASP A01 Broken Access Control).

folderLayout:
apps/
  web/  (Vue + Vite)
  api/  (NestJS)
    src/modules/
    prisma/schema.prisma
packages/
  shared/  (DTO types)
package.json  (npm workspaces)
docker-compose.yml
conventions: One Nest module per bounded context
DTOs validated with class-validator at the edge

adrs.title: TypeScript on both sides
adrs.decision: Web and API are TypeScript in one npm workspace.
adrs.why: One language, shared types, one toolchain for a small team.

adrs.title: Self-hosted identity provider
adrs.why: SSO and role management without writing auth code; no per-user fees.

repos.label: app
repos.layout: An npm workspace with apps/web, apps/api and packages/shared
